entities.summary: The extinction of the Rurikid dynasty, Boris Godunov's reign, the False Dmitry pretenders, Polish occupation of Moscow, famine and civil war, and the national uprising culminating in the election of Michael Romanov (1613) — founding the Romanov dynasty.
